summary: Measured conditional likelihood-interval coverage, bias, RMSE and width across 128 independent trials at each of eleven amplitudes, including exact and near boundaries and both empirical option-book exposure oracles. All trials use a fixed 8960 preparation/inverse-call schedule. Compared legacy and endpoint-inclusive inference on shared counts with an equal-query exact binomial classical baseline. Legacy intervals cover neither exact boundary; endpoint inclusion repairs support exclusion without claiming calibrated coverage. Added the measured study to the existing studio with trial-level evidence and numerical likelihood-set diagnostics.
